title: Add index management actions to update statistics per table or index
summary: Administrators can now update database statistics directly from the Index Management page for either a complete table or a specific enabled index to optimize query performance.
key_points: Adds two new actions: update table statistics and update index statistics
Requires confirmation and warns of temporary performance impact during update
Automatically refreshes page to display updated statistics timestamp after completion
SIFT indexes and disabled indexes are excluded from single-index updates
quote: Adds two actions to the Index Management page so administrators can update database statistics directly
